name: Robotics
description: Robot kinematics and dynamics, state estimation and SLAM, planning and control, and robot learning.

nodes.name: Robot systems
nodes.desc: Sensors, actuators, onboard compute and the sense-plan-act loop.
nodes.summary: You will be able to describe the parts of a robot system and how sensing, planning and acting fit together in a control loop.

nodes.name: Rotations & frames
nodes.desc: Coordinate frames, rotation matrices, quaternions and homogeneous transforms.
nodes.summary: You will be able to represent orientation and pose with rotation matrices, quaternions and homogeneous transforms between frames.

nodes.name: ROS basics
nodes.desc: Nodes, topics, services, launch files and tooling in ROS 2.
nodes.summary: You will be able to build ROS 2 applications from nodes communicating over topics and services and start them with launch files.
topics: Tools like rviz and ros2 bag

nodes.name: Sensors & actuators
nodes.desc: Encoders, IMUs, cameras, lidar, motors and their noise characteristics.
nodes.summary: You will be able to choose common robot sensors and actuators and account for their noise and limitations.

nodes.name: Forward kinematics
nodes.desc: Chaining joint transforms and Denavit-Hartenberg parameters.
nodes.summary: You will be able to compute an end-effector pose by chaining joint transforms using Denavit-Hartenberg parameters.
topics: Forward kinematics of a planar arm

nodes.name: Inverse kinematics
nodes.desc: Analytical and numerical IK and the Jacobian.
nodes.summary: You will be able to find joint angles for a desired pose with analytical and numerical inverse kinematics using the Jacobian.

nodes.name: Robot dynamics
nodes.desc: Forces, torques and equations of motion for manipulators.
nodes.summary: You will be able to relate forces and torques to motion and write equations of motion for manipulators.
topics: Mass matrix, Coriolis and gravity terms

nodes.name: Mobile robots
nodes.desc: Wheeled robot models, differential drive and odometry.
nodes.summary: You will be able to model wheeled robots, control differential drive motion and estimate pose with odometry.

nodes.name: State estimation
nodes.desc: The Bayes filter and fusing noisy sensor readings.
nodes.summary: You will be able to estimate a robot's state from noisy sensors using the Bayes filter framework.

nodes.name: Kalman filters
nodes.desc: Kalman and extended Kalman filters for tracking and fusion.
nodes.summary: You will be able to track and fuse sensor data with Kalman and extended Kalman filters.

nodes.name: Localisation
nodes.desc: Particle filters and map-based localisation.
nodes.summary: You will be able to localise a robot in a known map with particle filters and other map-based methods.

nodes.name: SLAM
nodes.desc: Simultaneous localisation and mapping with filters and pose graphs.
nodes.summary: You will understand how robots build a map while localising themselves using filter-based and pose-graph SLAM.

nodes.name: Robot perception
nodes.desc: Camera and lidar perception for obstacles and objects.
nodes.summary: You will be able to detect obstacles and objects from camera and lidar data for use in robot planning.

nodes.name: PID control
nodes.desc: Feedback control, PID tuning and stability intuition.
nodes.summary: You will be able to design and tune PID controllers for feedback control and reason about their stability.

nodes.name: Motion planning
nodes.desc: Configuration space, grid search, A*, RRT and PRM.
nodes.summary: You will be able to plan collision-free paths in configuration space using grid search, A* and sampling-based planners.

nodes.name: Trajectories
nodes.desc: Smooth trajectory generation and tracking.
nodes.summary: You will be able to generate smooth time-parameterised trajectories and track them with feedback controllers.

nodes.name: MPC
nodes.desc: Model predictive control as repeated constrained optimisation.
nodes.summary: You will understand model predictive control as repeatedly solving a constrained optimisation over a receding horizon.

nodes.name: Navigation stack
nodes.desc: Build a simulated robot that maps a space and navigates to goals.
nodes.summary: You will build a simulated robot that maps its environment and navigates autonomously to goal positions.

nodes.name: Robot learning
nodes.desc: Reinforcement learning for robots and the sim-to-real gap.
nodes.summary: You will be able to apply reinforcement learning to robots and explain techniques for bridging the sim-to-real gap.

nodes.name: Imitation learning
nodes.desc: Learning policies from demonstrations with behaviour cloning.
nodes.summary: You will be able to train robot policies from demonstrations with behaviour cloning and explain compounding errors.

nodes.name: Pick-and-place arm
nodes.desc: Program a simulated arm to detect, grasp and place objects.
nodes.summary: You will program a simulated robot arm to detect objects, plan grasps and place them at target locations.
